notes: The accepted alignment improperly combined two independently rendered morphemes in בְּשַׁלְוָה; “In” belongs to s001, while “time of security” belongs to s002.
The accepted noncompositional unit for s015–s016 was unnecessary: rule 14 assigns “nor” to the waw, and the repeated ancestor noun separately takes “fathers.”
The target head for אֲשֶׁר → “that which” was moved from the supplied antecedent “that” to the relative “which,” which directly realizes the source lexeme.
